title: AT&T and Tribeca Announce the 2026 AT&T Untold Stories Winner
summary: “Minnesota Goodbye” filmmaker will receive a $1.2 million production award and year-round mentorship ahead of its world premiere at the 2027 Tribeca Festival.
body_markdown: “Minnesota Goodbye” filmmaker will receive a $1.2 million production award and year-round mentorship ahead of its world premiere at the 2027 Tribeca Festival.
